authorization: Deeptanshu Kumar explicitly delegated final design, experiments and technical review to the assistant; no invented teammate signatures.
design_freeze: All fields fixed before seeds >=920000 are executed. No per-cell estimator switching, retrying failed inference, or post-hoc primary replacement.
primary_method: component_CR2_Satterthwaite; scalar PLR, identity working covariance; connected regime components plus singleton unexposed events
primary_learner: quadratic_ridge_logit: degree-2 RidgeCV outcome and logistic treatment; tuning inside outer training data
reference_method: unchanged legacy_overlap_CR0_normal; evaluated on the same cross-fitted residuals
primary_scope: Regime common-shock inference with sd_factor=0; factor-on is a prespecified omitted-dependence stress test. Historical DGP/source family unchanged.

control_acceptance.criterion: For every primary four-cell control/effect condition, 90% Wilson equivalence interval must lie within the stated engineering calibration band; failures/missing counts zero; absolute bias <= 0.1 times empirical estimate SD.
control_acceptance.interpretation: Meets a prespecified finite-grid engineering criterion, not proof of exact nominal coverage or universal validity.

H4.primary_match: unconditional probability two event windows share any regime shock
H4.secondary_match: fraction of event windows exposed to any regime
H4.limitations: Matching one quantity does not equalize the full covariance structure, exposed share, or shock-loading magnitudes. Report those rather than attributing every difference solely to K.

density_manipulation.criterion: Pair density and analytical average common-shock correlation ordered with configured density for each K; shared-pair counts scale quadratically with n at fixed K,density.

failure_policy: Retain all raw attempts and planned denominators. All paired contrasts require four successful cells sharing one world fingerprint. No clipping/fallback.
mc_precision: R500 nominal-coverage MCSE=.00975; control R2000 MCSE=.00487; robustness R300 MCSE=.01258. Report observed MCSE/Wilson and paired MCSE, never pool reused seeds as independent.
replication_check: Independent fresh-process source-pinned replay at rep IDs 0, midpoint and last on the selected core/H4 conditions; full raw arithmetic audited separately.
historical_inputs: Search and recover where possible; exclude unauthenticated legacy values from final result claims rather than fabricating original data.
canonicalization_note: Explicitly record the two false diagnostic-intervention defaults; no registered numerical design value changed and no final seed has been run.
